product_one_liner.value: Funnel collects and prepares marketing data from multiple sources for marketing and data teams to analyze, report on, and use in business decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: Funnel’s public help introduction describes collecting and preparing marketing data for reports and decisions, and names marketers and data teams as users.

pricing_page.notes: Funnel’s public Plans & prices page lists a starting monthly price and a demo link, establishing that it has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Funnel’s case-studies page shows the logos for Publicis Groupe, Uber, and Adidas, naming these as customers. | named_customers.0: The Funnel case-studies page displays the Publicis Groupe logo. | named_customers.1: The Funnel case-studies page displays the Uber logo. | named_customers.2: The Funnel case-studies page displays the Adidas logo.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 300 employees, which falls in the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Funnel’s location page identifies Stockholm, Sweden, and its careers location page labels this location as its headquarters. | hq_country: The Stockholm, Sweden location page and the company’s “Our HQ” page identify the headquarters as Stockholm, Sweden.

founded_year.notes: Funnel’s About page states that the company was founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The Dev Blog index lists multiple engineering-focused posts, including one about marketing-data engineering and another about the data-ingestion platform, with engineering leaders/CTO credited; this meets the two-post technical-blog criterion.

public_docs.notes: Funnel’s public knowledge-base collection says it contains eight Funnel AI articles and lists multiple articles, establishing a public help/documentation center with several articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers list includes Product Engineer - AI Product Experience, an open posting with AI in the title.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Funnel’s data privacy and security page identifies ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance, and says it has undergone a SOC 2 Type 2 attestation; these are the named items among the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly labels Funnel ISO 27001 certified. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly states Funnel has undergone a SOC 2 Type 2 attestation. | compliance_certs.2: The same security page names the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and says Funnel is compliant with it.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest round is identified as a loan/debt facility, so the stage is debt facility. | funding_date: The latest funding profile and Funnel’s release date the $80 million debt facility to January 28, 2026, yielding 2026-01. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies Funnel’s latest round as a $80M loan announced January 28, 2026, and Funnel’s own release confirms the $80 million debt facility.

raised_18mo.notes: Funnel announced its debt facility on January 28, 2026, which is within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers listing shows only two openings, Product Engineer - AI Product Experience and Measurement Consultant - Boston, neither an SDR/BDR nor account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 2026 release notes announce that customers can now create and manage client portals in Funnel AI and MCP; this is a new feature within the six-month period before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The LinkedIn-derived profile identifies Andrew Wellnitz as Funnel’s Chief Customer Officer and gives his start date at Funnel as 2026-04-01, within the prior 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Funnel’s SDR job posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as its CRM. | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR job posting names HubSpot as the company CRM.
